kinds.title: Microsoft SQL Server (Windows, or Linux / Docker; over SSH)

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: windows = PowerShell with integrated security as the SSH account; linux = sqlcmd with a SQL login, in a container when one is named

user.title: SSH user (Windows: an account that is sysadmin on the instance; Linux: a user allowed to run docker / podman)

ssh_host_key.title: SSH host key (known_hosts line or public key)

instance.title: Windows: instance name (empty = the default instance)

container.title: Linux: container name (empty = SQL Server installed on the host)

sqlcmd.title: Linux: sqlcmd (in the container or on the host)

sql_password.title: Linux: password of the SQL login

staging.title: Staging folder as SQL Server sees it (room for one full backup; emptied after each run)
staging.description: Windows default C:\NexusBackup\staging, Linux default /var/opt/mssql/nexus-staging (inside the container)

full_every_days.title: New full backup every … days (differential backups in between)

restores.title: Restore test (into a throwaway database on the source instance, DBCC CHECKDB, optional SQL check, dropped again)

sql.title: SQL check: one read-only query on the restored database; passes when its first value is true or not zero

target_time.title: Recover to time (empty = end of the backup; scheduled tests pick a random point)

restores.title: Point-in-time restore into a database on the source instance

database.title: Target database (a new name, or the existing one with Replace)

target_time.title: Recover to time (e.g. 2026-11-02 14:30:00+00; empty = end of the backup)

replace.title: Replace the existing database of that name

confirm.title: With Replace: type the database name again
